tool.name: GmxCheck
tool.description: : Wrapper of the GROMACS check module for comparing and validating GROMACS files.

param.name: input_structure_path
param.label: input TPR,GRO,G96,PDB,BRK,ENT file
param.help: Path to the first GROMACS run input file. Format: [input].[format]

param.name: input_structure_2_path
param.label: input TPR,GRO,G96,PDB,BRK,ENT file
param.help: Path to the second GROMACS run input file. Format: [input].[format]

param.name: input_traj_path
param.label: input XTC,TRR,CPT,GRO,G96,PDB,TNG file
param.help: Path to the first GROMACS trajectory file. Format: [input].[format]

param.name: input_traj_2_path
param.label: input XTC,TRR,CPT,GRO,G96,PDB,TNG file
param.help: Path to the second GROMACS trajectory file. Format: [input].[format]

param.name: input_energy_path
param.label: input EDR file
param.help: Path to the first GROMACS energy file. Format: [input].edr

param.name: input_energy_2_path
param.label: input EDR file
param.help: Path to the second GROMACS energy file. Format: [input].edr

param.name: structure_check_path
param.label: input TPR,GRO,G96,PDB,BRK,ENT file
param.help: Path to the structure file to analyze for internal consistency. Format: [input].[format]

param.name: input_index_path
param.label: input NDX file
param.help: Path to the GROMACS index file. Format: [input].ndx

param.name: outname_output_log_path
param.label: output TXT,LOG,OUT name
param.help: Path to the text file storing the gmx check console output Format: [output].[format]

param.name: sele
param.label: Take tool settings:
param.help: Select where tool settings are to be read from

param.name: properties
param.label: Configuration file
param.help: File containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: jsonstr
param.label: JSON string
param.help: JSON string containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: vdwfac
param.label: vdwfac
param.help: Fraction of the sum of Van der Waals radii used as warning cutoff.

param.name: bonlo
param.label: bonlo
param.help: Minimum fraction of the sum of Van der Waals radii for bonded atoms.

param.name: bonhi
param.label: bonhi
param.help: Maximum fraction of the sum of Van der Waals radii for bonded atoms.

param.name: relative_tolerance
param.label: relative_tolerance
param.help: Relative tolerance for comparing real values.

param.name: absolute_tolerance
param.label: absolute_tolerance
param.help: Absolute tolerance, useful when sums are close to zero.

param.name: rmsd
param.label: rmsd
param.help: Print RMSD for coordinates, velocities and forces.

param.name: compare_ab
param.label: compare_ab
param.help: Compare the A and B topologies from a single input file.

param.name: last_energy_term
param.label: last_energy_term
param.help: Last energy term to compare.

param.name: binary_path
param.label: binary_path
param.help: Path to the GROMACS executable binary.

param.name: output_format
param.label: output_format
param.help: Format of the output file
